LED Lighting Retrofits

Brighter spaces with efficient LED lighting

LED retrofits replace older bulbs and fixtures with efficient LED technology. You get better-quality light that uses less energy and lasts longer, so you change bulbs far less often.

Request a consultation (866) 504-8989
  • Less electricity used for the same amount of light
  • Long-lasting bulbs that reduce replacement and maintenance

Options

LED lighting retrofits options we offer

LED retrofits

Converting existing fixtures to LED, including recessed cans, linear fixtures and common bulb types.

Fixture upgrades

Replacing outdated fixtures with new LED fixtures for kitchens, living areas, garages and exteriors.

Controls

Dimmers, timers and sensors that keep lights off when they are not needed.

Benefits

Why upgrade

  • Less electricity used for the same amount of light
  • Long-lasting bulbs that reduce replacement and maintenance
  • Better light quality, with color options to suit each room
  • Less heat from fixtures compared with incandescent lighting

Is it time?

Signs this upgrade could help

  • You still use incandescent, halogen or fluorescent lighting
  • Bulbs burn out often or fixtures flicker
  • Some areas feel dim or have uneven light
  • You want to reduce energy use with a quick upgrade

Process

How your LED lighting retrofits project works

  1. Request a consultation

    Send the form or call us. Tell us about your property and the upgrades you are considering.

  2. Review your options

    We look at your home, explain suitable equipment and fixtures, and answer your questions.

  3. Check program fit

    We point out programs that may apply and what they typically require, before any work begins.

  4. Upgrade & follow up

    We schedule the installation, complete the work and walk you through your new equipment.

Programs

Programs that may apply

Depending on your property and eligibility, these programs may support this upgrade. We review the current details with you.

  • SoCalREN
  • MEA
  • CAMR

Incentive amounts, eligibility and funding availability are determined by each program and can change. They are not guaranteed. We will review current program information with you before you commit to any work.

FAQ

LED lighting retrofits questions

How much energy do LEDs save?

LEDs use significantly less electricity than incandescent and halogen bulbs to produce similar light. Actual savings depend on the fixtures replaced and how often lights are used.

Can you retrofit my existing fixtures?

In many cases, yes. Recessed cans and many common fixtures can be converted to LED. We will recommend a retrofit or a full fixture replacement based on what you have.

Do you offer lighting upgrades for businesses?

Contact us about your property. We will let you know which services are available for your building type.
